_source.atc: WHO Collaborating Centre for Drug Statistics Methodology, ATC/DDD Index (https://atcddd.fhi.no/atc_ddd_index/), index last updated 2026-01-20, checked 2026-10-22. Use of ATC codes in an open dataset is an open question (see README).
_source.rxnorm: NLM RxNav REST API (https://rxnav.nlm.nih.gov/), exact name, single ingredient (TTY=IN) only.
_source.licence: ATC codes are WHOCC material, excluded from the dataset's CC BY licence. Bare codes only: no ATC names, hierarchy or DDDs. Source: WHO Collaborating Centre for Drug Statistics Methodology, https://atcddd.fhi.no/copyright_disclaimer/
_source.rule: atc is null unless the index lists the name (or its WHO spelling) as a substance, or the name is a class matching exactly one ATC group. atcOther lists other codes the index gives the same substance; atc is the systemic code in the group that fits sleep use.

aceprometazine+meprobamate.note: Combination; aceprometazine is not listed by name. N05CX01 is a candidate, unconfirmed.
